caseName: Oklahoma Publishing Co. v. District Court ex rel. Oklahoma County
caseNameFull: Oklahoma Publishing Co. v. District Court in and for Oklahoma County

opinions.text: Application for stay of order of the District Court in and for Oklahoma County, filed August 4, 1976, presented to Mr. Justice White, and by him referred to the Court, denied for failure to comply with Rule 27 of this Court, but without prejudice to reapplying for an appropriate order should compliance with Rule 27 be effected.
